item.title: Check captions before the craft demo
item.summary: A coordinator and presenter plan captions for a glass-making demonstration.
item.transcript_text:
Facilitator: Our craft demonstration is tomorrow. The captions are ready for the video introduction. Have we sorted out the instructions during the live part?
Presenter: The local captioner can't start until half past one. The live demonstration begins at one. I could send a sheet with the key steps today.
Facilitator: The sheet helps, but people also need to follow your changes as you make them. Could we show the video first, then start live at half past one?
Presenter: Yes, if we leave the question box open during the video. That gets questions in before we begin. I'll send the sheet for people who want to read along.
Facilitator: Good. Ask the captioner to check the glass-making terms before the session.

questions.prompt: What problem chiefly shapes the revised programme?
options: A video that is missing important steps
Participants who want a longer question-and-answer session
A presenter who cannot travel to the venue
A gap in caption coverage for the live demonstration
questions.explanation: The presenter can send notes, but the organisers change the programme so the captioner can cover the live instructions.

questions.prompt: Why is the sheet alone insufficient?
options: Some visitors need the video introduction
The group needs to get questions in advance
Unplanned changes would be hard to follow
The presenter has written the sheet in another language
questions.explanation: The facilitator distinguishes fixed written steps from live adjustments people need to understand as they happen.

questions.prompt: What sequence do they agree to?
options: A video first, then the live demonstration at 1:30
A live demonstration first with a later video
A written sheet followed by questions the next day
questions.explanation: Moving the live portion to 1:30 lets the captioner cover it.

questions.prompt: What should the captioner check in advance?
options: The names of the people attending
questions.explanation: The facilitator asks for the technical glass-making terms to be checked.
